q23738.en: Parking and stopping are forbidden on bends and, outside built-up areas and on urban fast-flow roads, also near them.

explain.short: A car standing on a bend is seen too late by drivers coming round it. Outside towns and on fast urban roads traffic is faster, so the ban also covers the area near the bend.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'anche in loro prossimità' (also near them) extends the ban to the road just before and after the bend.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping or parking on or near a bend
lines: Car stopped on a bend outside town

q23739.en: Parking and stopping are forbidden near and at upright road signs, in a way that hides them from view.

explain.short: A stopped vehicle must never hide a road sign: other drivers need to see it. This is true even for a short stop.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'in modo da occultarne la vista' (so as to hide them): the ban is about blocking the view of the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Never hide a road sign, not even for a short stop
lines: Van stopped in front of a road sign

q23740.en: Parking and stopping are forbidden near and at traffic lights, in a way that hides them from view.

explain.short: A stopped vehicle must never hide traffic lights: drivers behind need to see them. This is true even for a short stop.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'in modo da occultarne la vista' (so as to hide them): the ban is about blocking the view of the lights.

sceneParams.caption: Never hide traffic lights, not even for a short stop
lines: Car stopped in front of traffic lights

q23741.en: Parking and stopping are forbidden on lane-selection road markings and along channelling lanes.

explain.short: Before a junction, arrows painted on the road send each driver into the right lane. A car stopped there blocks a lane that others must use.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'segnali orizzontali di preselezione' are the arrows on the lanes before a junction; 'corsie di canalizzazione' are the lanes they create.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping on the lane arrows before a junction
lines: A stopped car blocks the lane

q23742.en: Outside built-up areas, parking and stopping are forbidden at and near junction areas.

explain.short: A car standing at or near a junction hides the view and blocks vehicles that turn. So both stopping and parking are forbidden there.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'in corrispondenza e in prossimità' (at and near): the ban covers the junction and the road close to it.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping or parking at or near a junction
lines: Junction on a road outside town

q23743.en: Parking is forbidden on bends but, outside built-up areas and on fast-flow roads, it is not forbidden near them.

explain.short: It is the opposite: outside towns and on fast-flow roads the ban also covers the area NEAR the bend, because traffic there is faster.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'non è vietata in loro prossimità' (not forbidden near them) turns the real rule upside down.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: no parking near a bend either
lines: Car parked just before a bend

keywords.it: non è vietata in loro prossimità
keywords.en: it is not forbidden near them

q23744.en: Parking, but not stopping, is forbidden near and at traffic lights in a way that hides them from view.

explain.short: Traffic lights hidden even for a moment are dangerous. So both parking and stopping are forbidden there, not only parking.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'ma non la fermata' (but not stopping) is wrong: a short stop is forbidden too.

sceneParams.caption: Even a short stop must not hide traffic lights
lines: Car stops briefly before traffic lights

q23745.en: Parking is forbidden on lane-selection road markings but not along channelling lanes.

explain.short: Channelling lanes guide traffic into a junction, just like the arrows. A car parked there blocks the lane, so it is forbidden there too.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'ma non lungo le corsie di canalizzazione' (but not along channelling lanes) is wrong: those lanes are included.

sceneParams.caption: No parking along the channelling lanes either

q23746.en: Outside built-up areas, parking is forbidden at junction areas but not near them.

explain.short: Outside towns traffic is fast, and a car parked near a junction hides the view of crossing traffic. So the ban covers the area near the junction too.
explain.rule: Stopping and parking are both forbidden on bends, in front of signs or traffic lights (hiding them), on lane arrows and channelling lanes, and at junctions. Outside towns and on fast urban roads also NEAR bends and junctions.
explain.trap: 'ma non in loro prossimità' (but not near them) is wrong: near the junction is forbidden too.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: no parking near a junction either
lines: Junction on a road outside town

q23747.en: Parking is forbidden in front of the exit of driveways.

explain.short: A driveway (passo carrabile) must stay free so that people can drive in and out at any time.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in front of driveways. Stopping and parking are both forbidden on pedestrian crossings, on cycle tracks and their exits, and on pavements, even for a short time.
explain.trap: 'sbocco dei passi carrabili' means the place where the driveway meets the road.

sceneParams.caption: Never park in front of a driveway

q23748.en: Parking but not stopping is forbidden on pedestrian crossings.

explain.short: On a pedestrian crossing even a short stop is forbidden: the car blocks people walking and hides them from other drivers.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in front of driveways. Stopping and parking are both forbidden on pedestrian crossings, on cycle tracks and their exits, and on pavements, even for a short time.
explain.trap: 'ma non la fermata' (but not stopping) is wrong: stopping is forbidden too.

sceneParams.caption: No stopping on a pedestrian crossing, not even briefly
lines: Car stopped on a pedestrian crossing

q23749.en: Parking is forbidden on cycle tracks, but not where they come out onto the road, if it is short.

explain.short: Where a cycle track meets the road, cyclists need a free way out. Parking there is forbidden, even for a short time.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in front of driveways. Stopping and parking are both forbidden on pedestrian crossings, on cycle tracks and their exits, and on pavements, even for a short time.
explain.trap: 'nel caso sia di breve durata' (if it is short): a short time does not make it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: No parking at the end of a cycle track, even briefly
lines: Car at the end of a cycle track
Forbidden, even for a short time

q23750.en: Parking is allowed on pavements, only if it is short.

explain.short: Pavements are for pedestrians. Parking there is forbidden (unless a sign allows it), however short it is.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in front of driveways. Stopping and parking are both forbidden on pedestrian crossings, on cycle tracks and their exits, and on pavements, even for a short time.
explain.trap: 'solo se di breve durata' (only if short): how long you stay does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: No parking on the pavement, short or long
lines: Car with two wheels on the pavement
Pedestrians must walk in the road

q23751.en: Parking is forbidden if it prevents access to another vehicle already correctly parked.

explain.short: If your car blocks a correctly parked car, its driver cannot get in or drive away. So you must not park there.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'già regolarmente in sosta' (already correctly parked): the other car has the right to leave.

sceneParams.caption: Do not block a correctly parked car
lines: The other driver cannot get in

q23752.en: Parking is forbidden wherever it prevents parked vehicles from moving.

explain.short: Parked cars must be able to drive away. If your car stops them from moving out, you must not park there.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'dovunque' (wherever): the ban applies in any place where you block other parked vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Do not park where you block others from leaving
lines: Cars parked along a town street

q23753.en: Parking in double row is forbidden, unless they are two-wheeled vehicles.

explain.short: A car parked in the second row narrows the road and closes in the parked cars. Only two-wheeled vehicles are an exception.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'salvo che si tratti di veicoli a due ruote' (unless two-wheelers): the only exception.

sceneParams.caption: No double parking (except two-wheelers)

q23754.en: Parking is forbidden in spaces reserved for buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles to stand and stop.

explain.short: The bus stop must stay free, so buses and trams can stop close to the pavement and passengers can get on safely.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'veicoli circolanti su rotaia' means vehicles running on rails, such as trams.

sceneParams.caption: Keep bus and tram stops free
lines: Car parked at a bus stop
The bus cannot reach the stop

q23755.en: Parking is forbidden less than 15 metres from the stop sign of buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles, if the standing spaces are not marked.

explain.short: When the bus stop space is not painted on the road, the law fixes it for you: no parking closer than 15 metres to the stop sign.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'qualora ... non siano delimitati' (if not marked): the 15 metres apply when there are no markings.

sceneParams.caption: No parking within 15 m of an unmarked bus stop
lines: Bus stop sign, no road markings
Car parked close to the sign

q23756.en: Double parking of cars is allowed for a few minutes, by switching on the hazard lights.

explain.short: Double parking is forbidden for cars. Hazard lights do not make it allowed, not even for a few minutes.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'azionando le luci di emergenza' (switching on hazard lights) is a common excuse, not a permission.

sceneParams.caption: Hazard lights do not allow double parking
lines: Car in double row, hazard lights on

q23757.en: Double parking of cars is allowed as long as enough space remains for two rows of vehicles to drive.

explain.short: Double parking of cars is forbidden however wide the road is. It still closes in the cars parked beside it.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'purché rimanga spazio sufficiente' (as long as enough space remains) is an invented condition.

sceneParams.caption: Double parking is banned, even on a wide road
lines: Wide road, car in double row

q23758.en: Parking is allowed in spaces reserved for buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles to stand and stop, as long as it is short.

explain.short: A bus or tram can arrive at any moment. Parking in its stop space is forbidden, even for a short time.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden if it blocks parked vehicles, in double row (except two-wheelers), in bus and tram stop spaces, and within 15 metres of an unmarked stop sign.
explain.trap: 'purché sia di breve durata' (as long as it is short): a short time does not make it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: No parking at bus stops, even briefly
lines: Car parked at a bus stop

keywords.en: as long as it is short

q23759.en: Parking is forbidden in spaces reserved for public-hire vehicles (taxis).

explain.short: Taxi ranks must stay free for taxis waiting for customers. Other drivers must not park there.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'veicoli in servizio di piazza' is the official name for taxis.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi rank: no parking for other cars
lines: Taxi rank in a town square

q23760.en: Parking is forbidden on areas for the market and for vehicles loading and unloading goods, during the set hours.

explain.short: During the set hours these areas are needed for the market or for vans loading goods. Parking there blocks their work.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'nelle ore stabilite' (during the set hours): the ban applies at the times shown on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Market and loading areas: no parking in set hours
lines: Loading area in a town street
Car parked in the set hours

keywords.it: carico e lo scarico di cose

q23761.en: Parking is forbidden on verges, unless signs say otherwise.

explain.short: The verge (banchina) is the strip at the side of the carriageway. You may park there only when a sign allows it.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'salvo diversa segnalazione' (unless signs say otherwise): a sign can allow it.

sceneParams.caption: Verge: no parking unless a sign allows it

q23762.en: Parking is forbidden in spaces reserved for vehicles of disabled people to stop or park.

explain.short: These spaces are kept for disabled people, who need to park close by. Other drivers must never use them.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'veicoli per persone invalide' are vehicles serving disabled people (with the special permit).

sceneParams.caption: Disabled spaces: no parking for others
lines: A car without the permit parks there

q23763.en: Parking is forbidden at the ramps or links between pavements and carriageway used by vehicles of disabled people.

explain.short: A kerb ramp lets a wheelchair go from the pavement to the road. A car parked in front of it blocks the way.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'scivoli o raccordi' are the small ramps that join the pavement to the road.

sceneParams.caption: Never block a kerb ramp
lines: Kerb ramp between pavement and road
Car parked in front of it

q23764.en: Parking is allowed in spaces reserved for taxis only if it does not last a long time.

explain.short: Taxi spaces are only for taxis. Other cars must not park there, for a short or a long time.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'solo se non si protrae per lungo tempo' (only if not for long): how long you stay does not matter.

sceneParams.caption: Taxi spaces: no parking, even briefly
lines: Car parked at a taxi rank

keywords.it: non si protrae per lungo tempo
keywords.en: does not last a long time

q23765.en: Parking is allowed on areas for vehicles loading and unloading goods, during the set hours, only if it is short.

explain.short: During the set hours the loading area is only for vehicles that load or unload goods. Parking there is forbidden, even briefly.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'soltanto se di breve durata' (only if short): a short time does not make it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Loading area in set hours: no parking at all
lines: Loading area in the set hours
Car parked for a short time

keywords.it: carico e lo scarico di cose

q23766.en: Parking is allowed in spaces reserved for vehicles of disabled people to stop or park, as long as it is short.

explain.short: Disabled spaces are only for vehicles serving disabled people. Others must not park there, even for a short time.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in taxi spaces, market and loading areas (in the set hours), on verges unless signed, in disabled spaces and at their kerb ramps. A short time does not make it allowed.
explain.trap: 'purché di breve durata' (as long as it is short): a short time does not make it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Disabled spaces: no parking, even briefly
lines: Car parked in a disabled space

keywords.en: as long as it is short

q23767.en: Parking is forbidden in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport.

explain.short: Bus lanes must stay free so buses and taxis can move quickly. A parked car blocks the whole lane.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'mezzi pubblici' means public transport (buses, trams, taxis).

sceneParams.caption: No parking in a bus lane
lines: Bus lane in a town street

q23768.en: Parking is forbidden in urban pedestrian areas.

explain.short: A pedestrian area in town is only for people on foot. Vehicles may not park there.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'aree pedonali urbane' are town areas closed to traffic and kept for pedestrians.

sceneParams.caption: No parking in a pedestrian area

q23769.en: Parking is forbidden in limited traffic zones for vehicles that are not authorised.

explain.short: In a limited traffic zone (ZTL) only vehicles with a permit may drive and park. Without a permit, parking there is forbidden.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'per i veicoli non autorizzati' (for unauthorised vehicles): the ban is for vehicles without a permit.

sceneParams.caption: ZTL: no parking without a permit

q23770.en: Parking is forbidden in spaces for emergency or public-cleaning services shown by the proper signs.

explain.short: These spaces must be free for ambulances, fire engines or street-cleaning vehicles. A parked car could stop them working.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'igiene pubblica' (public hygiene) means services like street cleaning and rubbish collection.

sceneParams.caption: Emergency and cleaning spaces: no parking

q23771.en: Parking is forbidden in front of urban rubbish bins.

explain.short: The rubbish lorry must reach the bins to empty them. A car parked in front of them blocks the collection.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'cassonetti dei rifiuti urbani' are the large street bins for household rubbish.

sceneParams.caption: No parking in front of rubbish bins
lines: Car parked in front of them

q23772.en: Short parking is allowed in urban pedestrian areas.

explain.short: A pedestrian area is only for people on foot. Parking there is forbidden, even for a short time.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'Brevi soste' (short parking): a short time does not make it allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrian area: no parking, even briefly

q23773.en: Parking, and also stopping, are forbidden in spaces for emergency or public-cleaning services shown by the proper signs.

explain.short: In these spaces only parking (sosta) is forbidden. A short stop (fermata) to let someone in or out is allowed.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'ed anche la fermata' (and also stopping) is wrong: only parking is banned here.

sceneParams.caption: Only parking is banned here; a short stop is allowed
lines: Short stop to let someone out: OK

q23774.en: Parking as well as stopping are forbidden in front of urban rubbish bins.

explain.short: In front of rubbish bins only parking (sosta) is forbidden. A short stop (fermata) to let someone in or out is allowed.
explain.rule: Parking is forbidden in public-transport lanes, pedestrian areas, ZTL without permit, emergency/cleaning spaces and in front of bins. At emergency spaces and bins a short stop is still allowed.
explain.trap: 'così come la fermata' (as well as stopping) is wrong: only parking is banned here.

sceneParams.caption: Only parking is banned at bins; a short stop is allowed
lines: Short stop to let someone out: OK

q23776.en: In built-up areas the driver must not leave a trailer parked unhooked from its towing vehicle, unless signs say otherwise.

explain.short: A trailer left alone in a town street takes space and can be dangerous. So it is forbidden, unless signs allow it.
explain.rule: A parking ban written in the Code applies even without signs. In towns, no trailer may be left parked without its towing vehicle unless signs allow it.
explain.trap: 'salvo diversa segnalazione' (unless signs say otherwise): only a sign can allow it.

sceneParams.caption: In town: no trailer left without its towing vehicle
lines: Trailer unhooked in a town street
Left there without its towing vehicle

keywords.en: trailer unhooked from its towing vehicle

q23777.en: When parking is expressly forbidden by a rule of the Highway Code, the ban applies whether or not there are signs.

explain.short: Bans written in the Code (on bends, crossings, bus stops...) apply everywhere. There is no need for a sign to remind you.
explain.rule: A parking ban written in the Code applies even without signs. In towns, no trailer may be left parked without its towing vehicle unless signs allow it.
explain.trap: 'non è condizionata dalla presenza di cartelli' (does not depend on signs): the Code alone is enough.

sceneParams.caption: Code bans apply even with no sign
lines: No-parking rule in the Highway Code

q23778.en: Parking is forbidden at fuel stations, up to 5 metres before and after, even when the stations are closed.

explain.short: The Highway Code has no ban on parking 5 metres before and after a fuel station that is closed. You may park there if no other rule or sign forbids it.
explain.rule: A parking ban written in the Code applies even without signs. In towns, no trailer may be left parked without its towing vehicle unless signs allow it.
explain.trap: 'anche quando i distributori sono chiusi' (even when closed): this ban does not exist.

sceneParams.caption: No 5 m ban at a closed fuel station
lines: No such ban in the Code
Park if no sign or rule forbids it

keywords.it: sino a 5 metri prima e dopo
keywords.en: up to 5 metres before and after

q23778.reviewNote: Rule appears to come from the old Code; current art. 158 has no fuel-station ban, so the explanation says 'no such ban'. Check wording.

q23779.en: When parking is expressly forbidden by a rule of the Highway Code, obeying the ban still depends on the presence of signs.

explain.short: Bans written in the Code apply everywhere, with or without signs. You must know them yourself.
explain.rule: A parking ban written in the Code applies even without signs. In towns, no trailer may be left parked without its towing vehicle unless signs allow it.
explain.trap: 'comunque condizionata dalla presenza di cartelli' (still depends on signs) is wrong: the Code alone is enough.

sceneParams.caption: Code bans apply even without signs
lines: No-parking rule in the Highway Code

q23780.en: Parking in spaces reserved for buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles to stand and stop leads, among other things, to the loss of points from the licence.

explain.short: Blocking a bus or tram stop is a serious offence. Besides the fine, you lose points from your licence.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'tra l'altro' (among other things): the fine is not the only penalty.

sceneParams.caption: Parking at a bus stop: fine and licence points
lines: Car parked at a bus stop

q23781.en: Parking less than 15 metres from the bus stop sign, if the stop spaces are not marked, leads among other things to the loss of points from the licence.

explain.short: Near an unmarked bus stop the 15 metres belong to the bus. Parking there costs a fine and licence points.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'tra l'altro' (among other things): besides the fine, you lose points.

sceneParams.caption: Within 15 m of a bus stop: fine and points
lines: Car parked near a bus stop sign

q23782.en: Parking in spaces reserved for vehicles of disabled people to stop and park leads, among other things, to the loss of points from the licence.

explain.short: Taking a disabled person's space is a serious offence. Besides the fine, you lose points from your licence.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'tra l'altro' (among other things): besides the fine, you lose points.

sceneParams.caption: Disabled space: fine and licence points
lines: Car parked in a disabled space

q23783.en: Parking at the ramps or links between pavements and carriageway used by vehicles of disabled people leads, among other things, to the loss of points from the licence.

explain.short: Blocking a kerb ramp stops wheelchairs from passing. Besides the fine, you lose points from your licence.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'tra l'altro' (among other things): besides the fine, you lose points.

sceneParams.caption: Blocking a kerb ramp: fine and points
lines: Car parked in front of a kerb ramp

q23784.en: Parking in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport leads, among other things, to the loss of points from the licence.

explain.short: A car parked in a bus lane blocks public transport. Besides the fine, you lose points from your licence.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'tra l'altro' (among other things): besides the fine, you lose points.

sceneParams.caption: Parking in a bus lane: fine and points
lines: Car parked in a bus lane

q23785.en: Parking in spaces reserved for buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles to stand and stop is allowed if you use the parking disc.

explain.short: A parking disc (disco orario) is only for time-limited parking spaces. It never makes parking at a bus stop allowed.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'se si utilizza il disco orario' (if you use the parking disc): the disc changes nothing here.

sceneParams.caption: A parking disc does not allow parking at a bus stop
lines: Car at a bus stop with a parking disc

q23786.en: Parking less than 15 metres from the bus stop sign, if the standing spaces are not marked, is allowed by switching on the hazard warning lights (all four indicators flashing together).

explain.short: Within 15 metres of an unmarked bus stop parking is forbidden. Hazard lights never make a forbidden parking allowed.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'azionando la segnalazione luminosa di pericolo' (switching on hazard lights) is not a permission.

sceneParams.caption: Hazard lights do not allow parking at a bus stop
lines: Car near a bus stop, hazard lights on
Less than 15 m from the sign

q23787.en: Parking in spaces reserved for vehicles of disabled people to stop and park leads to a fine, but not to the loss of points from the driver's licence.

explain.short: Parking in a disabled space costs a fine AND licence points, not only a fine.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'ma non la sottrazione di punti' (but not the loss of points) is wrong: you lose points too.

sceneParams.caption: Disabled space: fine AND licence points
lines: Car parked in a disabled space

q23788.en: Parking at the ramps or links between pavements and carriageway used by vehicles of disabled people leads to the suspension of the licence.

explain.short: Blocking a kerb ramp costs a fine and licence points. The licence is not suspended for this.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'sospensione della patente' (licence suspension) is too heavy: the penalty is a fine and points.

sceneParams.caption: Kerb ramp: fine and points, not suspension
lines: Car parked in front of a kerb ramp

q23788.reviewNote: Check whether Legge 177/2024 added licence suspension (e.g. for repeat offences) for parking in disabled spaces or ramps.

q23789.en: Parking in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport is allowed in built-up areas from 22:00 to 8:00.

explain.short: Lanes reserved for public transport are for buses and taxis at all hours. Parking there is forbidden, day and night.
explain.rule: These parking offences (bus/tram stops, disabled spaces and ramps, public-transport lanes) cost a fine and licence points. No disc, hazard lights or time of day makes them allowed.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 22.00 alle ore 8.00' (from 22:00 to 8:00) is an invented time window.

sceneParams.caption: Bus lane: no parking, day or night
lines: Bus lane in town at night

q23790.en: An emergency stop is the interruption of the journey when the vehicle cannot be used because of a breakdown.

explain.short: If the car breaks down and cannot go on, you are forced to stop. This is exactly an emergency stop.
explain.rule: Emergency stop = the vehicle is broken down, or the driver or a passenger feels ill. Stopping for traffic is 'arresto'; letting people in or out is 'fermata'.
explain.trap: 'inutilizzabile per avaria' (unusable because of a breakdown) is one of the two real cases.

sceneParams.caption: Breakdown = emergency stop
lines: Car breaks down on the road

q23791.en: An emergency stop is the interruption of the journey when the vehicle must stop because the driver or a passenger feels ill.

explain.short: If the driver or a passenger suddenly feels ill, you must stop. This is an emergency stop.
explain.rule: Emergency stop = the vehicle is broken down, or the driver or a passenger feels ill. Stopping for traffic is 'arresto'; letting people in or out is 'fermata'.
explain.trap: 'malessere fisico' (feeling physically ill) is one of the two real cases.

sceneParams.caption: Feeling ill = emergency stop
lines: Stops the car at the side

q23792.en: An emergency stop is the interruption of the journey due to traffic needs.

explain.short: Stopping because of traffic (a red light, a queue) is called 'arresto'. An emergency stop is for a breakdown or illness.
explain.rule: Emergency stop = the vehicle is broken down, or the driver or a passenger feels ill. Stopping for traffic is 'arresto'; letting people in or out is 'fermata'.
explain.trap: 'esigenze della circolazione' (traffic needs) is the definition of 'arresto', not of the emergency stop.

sceneParams.caption: Stopping for traffic is 'arresto', not emergency
lines: Car stops in a queue at traffic lights

q23793.en: An emergency stop is the temporary halt of the journey to let a disabled person get out.

explain.short: Stopping briefly to let a person (also a disabled person) get out is a 'fermata'. An emergency stop is for a breakdown or illness.
explain.rule: Emergency stop = the vehicle is broken down, or the driver or a passenger feels ill. Stopping for traffic is 'arresto'; letting people in or out is 'fermata'.
explain.trap: 'per consentire la discesa' (to let someone get out) describes a 'fermata', not an emergency stop.

sceneParams.caption: Letting someone out is a 'fermata'
lines: Car stops to let a disabled person out

q23794.en: An emergency stop is the temporary halt of the journey to let a disabled person get into the vehicle.

explain.short: Stopping briefly to let a person (also a disabled person) get in is a 'fermata'. An emergency stop is for a breakdown or illness.
explain.rule: Emergency stop = the vehicle is broken down, or the driver or a passenger feels ill. Stopping for traffic is 'arresto'; letting people in or out is 'fermata'.
explain.trap: 'di salire sul veicolo' (to get in) describes a 'fermata', not an emergency stop.

sceneParams.caption: Letting someone in is a 'fermata'
lines: Car stops to let a disabled person in

q23795.en: When you open the doors of a vehicle, you must make sure that this is no danger or obstacle for other road users.

explain.short: An open door can hit a cyclist, a car or a pedestrian. So you check first and open only when it is safe.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'bisogna assicurarsi' (you must make sure): checking before opening is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Check before you open a door
lines: Parked car, door about to open
Check for bikes and cars behind
Open only when it is safe

q23796.en: Before opening a vehicle door on the side facing the middle of the road, you must make sure that no other vehicles are coming.

explain.short: On the road side, cars and bikes pass close to your door. Look (also in the mirror) before you open it.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'verso il centro della strada' (towards the middle of the road): the side where traffic passes.

sceneParams.caption: Road-side door: check traffic first
lines: Check that no vehicle is coming

q23797.en: Before opening a vehicle door on the side facing the pavement, you must make sure that no pedestrians are coming.

explain.short: On the pavement side, people walk close to the car. A door opened suddenly can hit them, so check first.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'verso il marciapiede' (towards the pavement): on this side you watch for pedestrians.

sceneParams.caption: Pavement-side door: check for pedestrians
lines: Check that no pedestrian is coming

q23798.en: When getting out of a vehicle, you must make sure that this is no danger or obstacle for other road users.

explain.short: When you get out you stand in the road for a moment. Check first, so you do not put yourself or others at risk.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'bisogna assicurarsi' (you must make sure): checking before getting out is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Check before you get out
lines: Check the road around the car
Get out only when it is safe

q23799.en: When about to get out of the car, the driver must make sure, also by using the rear-view mirror, that no other vehicles are coming.

explain.short: The mirror shows cars and bikes coming from behind. Look in it before you open the door and get out.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'anche mediante lo specchietto retrovisore' (also with the mirror): the mirror is part of the check.

sceneParams.caption: Use the mirror before getting out
lines: Look in the mirror for traffic
Get out when nobody is coming

q23800.en: Before getting out of a parked vehicle, the driver must make sure the engine is switched off.

explain.short: A parked car with the engine running wastes fuel, pollutes and could move. Switch the engine off before you get out.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'deve assicurarsi di avere spento il motore' (must make sure the engine is off): this is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Engine off before you leave the car
lines: Car parked, driver about to get out

q23801.en: Opening a vehicle door on the pavement side means you must switch on the indicator on that side.

explain.short: No indicator is needed to open a door. You only have to check that no pedestrian or vehicle is coming.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'l'obbligo di attivare l'indicatore di direzione' (must switch on the indicator) is an invented duty.

sceneParams.caption: No indicator needed: just check it is safe

q23802.en: Opening the vehicle doors on the side facing the middle of the road is forbidden.

explain.short: You may open the road-side door. You must only check first that no vehicles are coming.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'è vietato' (is forbidden) is wrong: it is allowed with care.

sceneParams.caption: Road-side door: allowed, after checking traffic
lines: Check that no vehicle is coming

q23803.en: The driver may leave the vehicle parked with the engine running to keep the air conditioning working.

explain.short: During parking the engine must be off. Keeping it running for the air conditioning is forbidden.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'con il motore acceso' (with the engine running): not allowed, not even for the air conditioning.

sceneParams.caption: No engine running for the air conditioning

q23804.en: Before getting out of a parked vehicle, the driver must pull the handbrake on all downhill roads but not on uphill ones.

explain.short: A car can roll backwards on an uphill road too. Always pull the handbrake before leaving the car, uphill or downhill.
explain.rule: Open doors or get out only after checking, also in the mirror, that no one is coming. Leave a parked car with the engine off and the handbrake on.
explain.trap: 'ma non in quelle in salita' (but not uphill) is wrong: the handbrake is needed on every slope.

sceneParams.caption: Handbrake on uphill AND downhill
lines: Car parked on an uphill road
No handbrake: it can roll back
